2.source: relic set 304 (筑城者的贝洛伯格 / Belobog of the Architects), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's DEF by #1[i]%. When the wearer's Effect Hit Rate is equal to or higher than #2[i]%, increases the wearer's DEF by an extra #3[i]%." param = [0.15, 0.5, 0.15]
2.note: Only the conditional sentence; "DEF +15%" is the effect's `properties` stat (DefenceAddedRatio 0.15). ⚠ The threshold is 50% written as a FRACTION: `self_attr:EFFECT_HIT_RATE >= 0.5`. Effect Hit Rate is a ratio attribute, so it reads as a fraction everywhere (the same number `Battle.hitChance` multiplies with) -- `>= 50` would load and never fire. This is the case that made the unit rule explicit in engine.md 4.6. ⚠ Same BATTLE_START approximation as sets 301/302/307/309.
